hotspots.title: Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's new diesel agreement with Russia has ignited fierce criticism from GOP senators and anti‑inflation advocates, who warn it threatens U.S. energy security and fuels political firestorms.
hotspots.affect: The story is framed as a betrayal and catastrophic policy move, driving polarized outrage across the right‑wing media ecosystem.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Violence & Outbursts
